That fell to -15.7 from -15.0 previously, reflecting a modest decline after the slump in the prior month. The cycle of revenge attacks continue as the country heads towards its first election since independence. New contemporary sculpture replaces the globe in the original Roman artifact with a cup as a tribute. The cup is considered one of the seven glass wonders of the world, one of just 40 glass cage cups that survived. Exactly why the unusual color effects of the Lycurgus Cup occurred was a mystery until 2007 , when a team of scientists discovered the color shifts were due to the presence of nanoparticles in the glass—the result of Roman artisans adding finely ground gold and silver into the mix. Those nanoparticles change how the electrons in the cup vibrate in response to light so that the color one sees shifts with the observer’s vantage point.

MyGolfSpy reports golfers should quit apologizing for bad shots, declining bets, or playing from shorter tees to enjoy the game without guilt. Many golfers introduce themselves with a disclaimer about their handicap before the first tee. This habit aims to lower expectations and reassure strangers of their limitations. However, the pressure to apologize for a topped drive or a three-putt is unfounded. Even the best golfers in the world simply want their playing partners to move things along. Speed of play matters more than perfect execution. A bad shot does not require a public statement or a formal apology for taking up space.

The UIL approved a phased rollout of a 35-second shot clock for boys and girls varsity basketball beginning no earlier than 2028-29. Classes 1A and 2A would begin no earlier than 2032-33.

Genie 4 will roll out to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers soon. It’s easy to look at the output of Genie 4 and see a video game, which is why Genie 3 caused so much consternation in the gaming industry. DeepMind doesn’t think about it that way, though. According to Google , world models are a key element in the march toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). A world model creates a virtual world, but it doesn’t require pre-rendering environments or programming interactive elements. You simply tell the model what you want, and it generates the experience frame by frame in real time as you explore it.

Blue marlin are typically encountered 1,000 miles south off Mexico. Michael Mackenbach hooked the 595-pound blue marlin 12 miles offshore and fought the billfish for 2.5-hours aboard a 20-foot boat. According to BD Outdoors , Mackenbach intended to release the marlin but it died during the fight. Blue marlin are more commonly found in areas off Mexico, such as Cabo San Lucas, nearly 1,000 miles south of San Pedro. Catches off Southern California are exceedingly rare in normal times, when sea-surface temperatures are significantly cooler than the mid-70s still being registered offshore.

Has a team in the World Series ever taken a 3-0 lead and lost the series? The answer is 'not even close,' as it turns out. Whether or not it happens Tuesday at Tropicana Field, history is overwhelmingly on Milwaukee's side. On 25 previous occasions since 1903 when a team went up in the World Series, 3-0, that team won the World Series all 25 times. The only example of a team coming back in a best-of-seven format from a 3-0 deficit was a memorable 2004 Boston Red Sox rally against the New York Yankees , the only time in 43 opportunities that a best-of-seven series featured a team ahead, 3-0, and losing the series. The Red Sox went on to win the World Series.

Peter Dobing, Stoke City's captain when they won the League Cup in 1972, dies at the age of 87. Manchester-born Dobing is best remembered in the Potteries as Stoke's skipper when they lifted the trophy by beating Chelsea at Wembley in 1972. Dobing, who began his career at Blackburn Rovers, made 377 appearances and scored 95 goals for the Potters after being signed by manager Tony Waddington from Manchester City for a then club record £37,500 in 1963. He had already made one previous appearance at Wembley, for Blackburn in 1960, when he scored five times in their run to the FA Cup final, only to lose 3-0 to Wolves.
